findings.reason: F0003:S3:T2:A11 cites Results and Figures 3–4, but does not specify whether the extracted summaries were transcribed or digitized. A13 explicitly identifies group means ± SEM without strain-resolved allocation; sample counts and animal identifiers are not supplied. A14 prohibits interpreting repeated control values as independent cohorts. Identical bacterial-burden controls at D17/D23 and hemorrhage-score controls at D21/D27 must retain their separate comparison contexts without inventing cohort independence.
findings.needed_material: Preserve all original rows and SEM values; obtain source-supported extraction provenance, sample counts, strain allocation and control-cohort relationships where available before making dependent joins or experimental-unit claims.

findings.reason: A13 states IV administration and mg/kg doses, but bolus versus infusion, infusion duration, formulation, salt/free-base dose basis and analytical analyte identity are NOT_FOUND. No total/unbound exposure basis or physiological bridge is supplied. The route category remains NOT_FOUND because IV alone does not distinguish the permitted intravenous categories.
findings.needed_material: Retain IV and the stated doses unchanged; obtain administration and formulation details and relevant analyte/exposure definitions before linking these outcomes to PK or proposing conversions.

findings.reason: Available inputs include neutropenic rabbit characteristics, K. pneumoniae strain identities, a shared MIC, PMB dosing, untreated comparators and three response endpoints for 7- and 14-day treatment courses. Inoculum, infection-to-treatment interval, exact response observation timing, treatment-start bacterial baseline, untreated growth trajectories, MIC method/medium/standard/replicates/summary definition, strain-resolved responses and source-linked exposure inputs are NOT_FOUND. Only one PMB dosing schedule is stated; dosing-frequency variation separating candidate indices is not established. Separate PK-to-PD compatibility cannot be assessed from this page.
findings.needed_material: Source-supported infection and susceptibility methods, endpoint timing and baseline definitions, strain allocation, regimen-to-exposure-to-response mapping and any interval-varying design evidence. Keep the two treatment durations and all endpoint types distinct.

findings.reason: This page does not define K. pneumoniae stasis relative to a treatment-start baseline, or supply matched free-exposure inputs. Its bacterial-burden endpoint and untreated comparators do not alone establish a stasis target. The separate 1-log and 2-log kill definitions required by DR027 and DR028 are likewise not supplied; none of these target requirements is matched by this item.
findings.needed_material: For DR026, DR027 and DR028 separately, specify the desired effect, reference baseline/comparator, endpoint time/window, strain applicability and matched exposure-response inputs. Do not derive kill targets from absolute endpoint burdens or substitute other-pathogen targets.
